title: NATO summit live: Russia launches deadly strikes on Ukraine as Trump, Zelensky set to meet
summary: Russia's ⁠overnight attack on Ukraine killed three people, including a fifteen-year-old boy and his mother, according to local officials on Wednesday. Moscow has continued its attacks on Ukraine ahead of a planned meeting between US President Donald Trump and his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky at the second day of a NATO summit in Ankara. contentText: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he was “very upset with NATO” after alliance members continued their resistance to his desire to acquire Greenland for the United States from member state Denmark. Speaking to reporters alongside NATO chief Rutte at the summit in Ankara, he also repeated complaints about how allies "were unwilling to help us” in the US-Israel war against Iran. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
